title: When a borrow ends
prompt: When does a borrow actually end: at the closing brace, or somewhere else?
answer: At its last USE. Since non-lexical lifetimes, the compiler tracks where a reference is last used, so a borrow whose final use is on line 3 stops borrowing there, and you may mutate the owner on line 4.

example.caption: The borrow ends at its last use, not the brace.
